panels.description: Tomas takes the old key from his jacket and faces Alex at a concealed vent housing. Leave upper wall space.
The old key enters the vent housing's mechanical lock. Keep the key and lock unobstructed.
Tomas throws an emergency lever; the Site 6 bay flashes amber. Alex, Ada, B11 and TJ are positioned at the opening without crowding; leave upper space for the alarm.
Alex, Ada, B11 and TJ slip through the old route while Tomas remains at the lever behind them. Keep Tomas separated from the escaping group and leave upper space.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: Adrian asked me to keep this door closed.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: From anyone who came for the work.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: Go. I’m about to become paperwork.
